reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getMonthBudgetCategories policy and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, plus getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages and the mutator(undoable) registration.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; only the one-line `sum-amount-` sheet read resembles the read inside getCategoryAverage.

placement.why: Action sits in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings, registered in app.ts, with a test in actions.test.ts.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean and consistent, though it borrows the 'average' action kind and the average-named sign helper for a non-average action instead of naming its own variant.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through getMonthBudgetCategories and averageToBudgetAmount from month-action-categories.ts.
